## Personality

Minnie Andrews is regarded by her teacher as a model pupil. However, she is also described as dull, poky, and lacking in imagination or liveliness, rarely appearing to enjoy herself.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Minnie Andrews is a classmate who warmly welcomes [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to school when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns following her dramatic parting with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Later in the school term, Minnie is present as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) says emotional farewells to her classmates on the final day of school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## Relationships

### [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/minnie-andrews--phillips.md)

Minnie Andrews is a pupil in Mr. Phillips's schoolroom. She is part of the class of students who warmly welcome [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) back when she decides to return to school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), +2 more_
